response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), a AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS avg_n FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_kept_ratios, SUM(g.n) AS total_spatial_records, AVG(g.n - a.avg_n) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.n > a.avg_n

assumptions.assumption: Spatial records with no matching project are excluded (inner join). A NULL fundflux forms its own group.
The number of spatial records per source counts every joined record, including those whose boxy or boxz is missing. Only the ratio average ignores them.
The cross-source average is the mean of the per-source counts, with each funding source weighted equally. It is not the mean over individual records.
The result averages the per-source average ratios, so each kept source is weighted equally. It does not pool all records across the kept sources.
A boxz of 0 is treated as a missing ratio (NULLIF) to avoid division by zero.
